w: In the morning Pramukh Swami Maharaj went for darshan in Yogiji Maharaj's room. A sadhu, recalling a sacred saying of Yogiji Maharaj, said, "Yogiji Maharaj said, 'We have been in satsang for 50 years. From the great Sadguru we have learnt only one thing: do not get into intrigue. Do not see faults even in the thorns of the Gunatit garden.'"

Walking around the murti of Yogiji Maharaj, Swamishri said, "Khat and pat (intrigue)." Then he said, "Do not see faults even in a thorn. If a thorn pricks, you have to take it out, don't you!" After a few moments he said, "A thorn means what someone has said or done. Pull that thorn out slowly. If one believes, 'I am the atma, I am Akshar,' then the thorn will not prick. Can one say, 'You are like this, you are like that...'? If a thorn (of words, of insult) pricks, do not go around telling anyone. Pull it out slowly. No one should come to know."
A few words of Swamishri are guidance that lights up life.

The evening assembly programs were presented by children members of Satsang as part of Bal Day. They sang bhajans, delivered speeches, presented a quiz program and a drama on the power of the Swaminarayan Mahamantra.

In the evening Satsang assembly the bal karyakars performed a drama, "Suvarna Avsar", to announce the golden jubilee celebration of BAPS children's activities. The drama written by Jayendra Vinchhi, showed the highlights of the development and progress of BAPS children's activities and an inspiring note for all bal karyakars to further propel its activities. Finally, the program was blessed by Swamishri, "Yogiji Maharaj had great foresight. He knew the situations of the past, present and future. He was aware that Kaliyug is an age full of enticements. In this a person loses his character and pride. So he established Bal Mandals so that children could attain character and spirituality ..."

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
22 Dec 2002, Ataldra
34 balaks pilgrimaged 25 km by foot from Ranoli to Atladra.
Swamishri performed the yagna rituals on the eve of the murti-pratishtha ceremony. Thereafter he performed puja and arti of the deities and blessed the assembly.
From 4.10 p.m.
At 7.00 p.m. Swamishri arrived at the Gujarati Samaj Bhavan for the evening satsang assembly. Members of 35 Gujarati organisations honored Swamishri.

At 7.00 pm Swamishri was welcomed with fireworks on his arrival on stage. More than 35,000 devotees clapped and welcomed Swamishri. BAPS youths and children performed two traditional welcome dances. Thereafter Swamishri was garlanded by senior sadhus, devotees and dignitaries. In his blessings Swamishri said, “Through the wish of Yogiji Maharaj grand mandirs have been accomplished, there is a large number of sadhus and satsang is growing in the world. The Akshardham in Delhi has been accomplished through the wish of Yogiji Maharaj. Through God’s wish and inspiration the mandir has been realised. God is the all-doer…”

The Kishoris of Gandhinagar performed three-day fast taking water only.

Sixty female and sixty male devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Kadi.
18 December 2005, Gandhinagar
Ten kishores and nine kishori pilgrimaged by foot from Kalol.
20 December 2005, Gandhinagar
Ten male and seven female BAPS youths observed 85- hours of waterless fast and forty-nine youths observed a fast on water only.
A devotee observed a 7-day liquid fast and pilgrimaged 16 km by foot. Two young girls, one five years old and another 2.1/2 years old, observed 85 hour liquid fast.

Two children pilgrimaged 15 km by foot from Andada village.
24 December 2005, Bharuch
To please Swamishri male and female volunteers of the Children’s Forum had performed 36,381 malas, 172,213 pradakshinas, 18,716 dandvat, 150,636 panchang pranam.

Eight children of Ankleshwar bal mandal pilgrimaged 11 km by foot, doing mala along the way. Three youths and five female devotees of Nahiyer pilgrimaged 42 km by foot in 11 hrs. Eight devotees of Amod pilgrimaged 45 km by foot.

During Pramukh Swami Maharaj's stay, letters large and small had come from local devotees and sadhus, and at the last moment Swamishri gave, without writing anything down, notes on what guidance was to be given to whom and where. Further, before leaving, while going to the bathroom, he remembered something and called back Abhayswarup Swami, who had gone out.
Abhayswarup Swami casually asked, "How do you remember all this so easily?"
Smiling meaningfully, Swamishri said, "It is the grace of Shastriji Maharaj, and Shastriji Maharaj and Jogi Bapa gave a lot of training, so everything happens by their grace."
Quite naturally, Swamishri offered this credit too at the feet of his gurus. A heavy word like "leadership" seems very small before the ways of Swamishri's leadership.

During the reading of letters, a sadhu phoned. He said, "I am only a little educated, and I have to go and speak in an assembly of educated people."

Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "There is no problem in that; what loss can there be in giving katha and talks? We are the atma. Speak remembering God. Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj will be pleased."

Midway through his walk, Pramukh Swami Maharaj was seated on a chair. Meanwhile Balmukund, a physiotherapist from Jaipur, said to Swamishri, "When you walk, walk with your chest out. Not looking down like this."
Swamishri, still sitting, at once acted as if pushing his chest out and said, "Walking with the chest out brings pride. So it is better to walk looking down."

A seeker said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "My wife keeps asking me, 'You have so many problems right now; don't you worry?' Then I tell her, 'Bapa is there, isn't he!' And she says, 'You have got into the habit of dragging Bapa into everything.'"
Hearing this, Swamishri said, laughing, "When we leave it to God, God does everything."

Today, as Mahant Swami Maharaj set out for the assembly hall to install murtis for various mandirs, the youths serving in the courtyard of the sadhus' ashram, referring to the lesson of Brahmavidya he had given in the morning, asked him, "We will tolerate however much insult comes. Then you will keep us in satsang, won't you?"
"One who tolerates will surely remain," Swamishri said.
In his words, everyone saw the firm foundation of satsang.
Today before eating, Mahant Swami Maharaj yawned. The sadhus said, "It seems the meetings have tired you..."
Swamishri said, "What is this tiredness? It is eating that tires me."
What a state this is! Giving 1,044 meetings does not tire him, but eating tires him!!
The arithmetic of the Satpurush is different from ours.
